responsibility: This scheduling description models Niagara-7 (the M7 core) for the SPARC scheduler. It captures the dual-slot issue queue, integer and load/store execution in slot0, branch/FP/VIS execution in slot1, high-latency divide and GSR operations, and VIS bypass behavior, providing a newer Oracle-core timing model that is distinct from both Niagara-4 and the four-slot M8 scheduler model.
